atoms.b: One day, Sonja’s dad took her to the Houses of Parliament in London. They got to go inside and look around. It was so big! There was a huge clock tower next to it, and each hour, the bells rang. Sonja even got to talk to someone her dad called their 'MP'.

atoms.b: Sonja asked her dad a lot of questions. She found out that most of the people in the Houses of Parliament work for the government. They help make the laws that we have in our country. Sonja wants to come back someday and maybe even work there when she is older.
